additional_primary_source.title: Sinha and Samuel, Inequivalence of Statistical Ensembles in Single Molecule Measurements
additional_primary_source.access: Root and author independently read PDF Sections II and III.
additional_primary_source.scope: Section II specifies a trap free in transverse directions and distinguishes stiff longitudinal and constant-force limits. Its partition functions are Laplace transforms, becoming Legendre related only with a suitable saddle-point limit. Section III gives a single-rod flat projected density and zero interior holding force, contrasted with its force-controlled mean extension. These directly support the apparatus distinction and ungraded N=1 check. Our finite-N freely jointed convolution and numerical reference are derived independently.
additional_primary_source.not_claimed: The paper is not used as a source for an exact finite-N freely jointed clamp formula.
